Patrick —

Appreciate the fast feedback. I mapped your asks to the MAP and propose the following concrete commitments we can include as milestones: 

- Week 0 (this week): Agree MAP baseline and DPA scope; Redwood to acknowledge DPA redline items we cannot accept in-principle.
- Week 1–2: SIG/CAIQ draft completed with evidence pointers; provide answers + sample evidence links for ~70% of questions.
- Week 2–4: SOC 2 evidence package for in-scope controls (monitoring, key management, separation) uploaded to shared Drive.
- Week 3–5: Final DPA negotiation and DocuSign execution.

Retention commitments (proposed mapping):
- Transactional events: 90 days (searchable index in live system) — aligns to your ask.
- Auth/API logs: 1 year in SIEM; 90 days hot storage, 275 days cold logs accessible via search (we can export on request).
- Customer snapshots/backups: 3 years by default; option for 7–10 year archival by request and with cost impact.
- Legal hold/archival: escrow + immutable backup for covered customers; retention extension requires signed amendment.

EU residency: Yes — we can pin data to EU region for a subset of customer tenants (requires dedicated routing and minimal configuration; we’ll add this as a MAP milestone).

Notes on DPA redlines you highlighted: 
- Breach notification SLA: we can commit to 72 hours for notification and initial triage details, with a 30-day remediation/update cadence unless earlier info is available.
- Right to audit clause: we can accept audits via shared evidence and a semi-annual tabletop; for an on-site audit we will require 30 days notice and a scoped engagement fee.

Attached are the SOC2_evidence_checklist.pdf and an initial SIG_answers_draft.xlsx with the first tranche of responses.

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet and propose milestone dates once Patrick confirms the retention windows (especially whether 10-year archival is required for any line of business).

Thanks,
